method.baseline: Fixed brand chosen only from development outcomes; support majority uses the five supplied observations. Ties use sorted candidate IDs, matching project baselines.
method.uncited_controls: Only type/count-matched random removals with no cited IDs; require all five matched removals before including a case. Average controls within each case, then average cases.
method.illustrations: Explanation illustrations retain the development workflow case and first incorrect paired test example. Counterfactual illustrations show cited removal, comparable uncited removal, a price edit, and presentation order. Choose the first measured cited/uncited pair with equal removal counts by evidence type and identical source prediction/explanation; a keep-cited measurement qualifies when its actual masked complement is wholly uncited and type/count matched. Choose the first measured with-history price edit and ordering test, falling back to either condition. Selection does not require an answer change.
